name: Clockwork Assistant stands about as tall as a gnome (#5411)
contract: #5411 reports that the Clockwork Assistant built by Build: Clockwork Assistant 803436 dwarfs dwarves and should stand about as tall as a gnome. The pet 60070 uses display 40388 (model worserobot_nobelt_COA.m2), which the client DBC scales by 1.5 while its sibling displays 40387 and 40389-40397 of the same model use 1.0. The model's CreatureModelData bounding box is 1.863 high, so at object scale 1 the pet stands 2.79 against 1.60 for DwarfMale and 1.30 for GnomeMale; Mechano-Bear (display 94943, 1.936 at 0.75) stands 1.45. The client multiplies the display scale by the object scale the server sends from creature_template_model.DisplayScale. At 0.5 the Clockwork Assistant stands 1.40, between a gnome and a dwarf and level with Mechano-Bear. A level 80 Tinker builds the pet and the server-side object scale is read.
